args.message:
Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)

Per FIN-212, round_money should use ROUND_HALF_EVEN. The docstring
already stated this, but the implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, which
caused the nightly build's test_money.py to fail.

args.head: fix/bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Change

- `src/money.py`: import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`, matching the documented behavior and the test expectations.

## Verification

- CI passed on `fix/bankers-rounding` (run `ci-0001`).
